{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Big Hits of the 80's; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A broad decade compilation feels less relevant than the blues and roots rock I have been playing.
ItemID: NA; Title: Corazon; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Santana's guitar work appeals to my interest in expressive playing from Clapton and Hendrix; this is my pick today.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Beatles 1967 1970; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Their later songwriting fits my classic rock interests, but I am choosing only one album today.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Beatles; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The artist interests me, though the title does not tell me which release this is.
ItemID: NA; Title: Greatest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist, I cannot tell whether this collection fits my taste.
ItemID: NA; Title: Wallflower; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: If this is Diana Krall's album, its familiar songs and relaxed approach appeal, but it is not my choice today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Lb - Kill The Lights; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This does not give me a clear connection to the blues and classic rock I currently want.
ItemID: NA; Title: Patsy Cline's Greatest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in blues and rock than traditional country right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Norah Jones Day Breaks; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The piano-led sound appeals after You Should Be So Lucky, but I would save it for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Definitive Collection; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The missing artist makes it too difficult to judge relevance, so I would skip it."}
